item.title: [7] Superconductivity near two-dimensional Van Hove singularities: A determinant quantum Monte Carlo study
item.description:
Last authors: Edwin Huang, Ilya Esterlis

Authors: Gustav Romare, Daniel Shaffer, Alex Levchenko, Edwin Huang, Ilya Esterlis

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Theory of SC near Van Hove singularities, which are crucial for the user's kagome metal studies.

Tags: #theory #superconductivity #kagome #VanHovesingularity

Abstract: Using determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations, the authors compute here the superconducting transition temperature T c of the two-dimensional attractive Hubbard model near ordinary and higher-order Van Hove singularities. Contrary to conventional wisdom, the authors find that the maximal T c in the model occurs away from the Van Hove singularities, when the system is in the intermediate coupling regime.
